description: This file defines an abstract Java class 'HonoUserAdapter' which implements the 'HonoUser' interface. The class provides default implementations for methods related to user information such as name, authorities, token, expiration check, and expiration time, mostly returning null or basic default values. It serves as a base class for other classes to override specific behaviors.

classes.name: HonoUserAdapter
classes.description: An abstract adapter class implementing 'HonoUser' with default method implementations, intended to be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if the current time is not before the expiration time; returns true if expired.

methods.name: getExpirationTime
methods.description: Returns the current time plus 10 minutes as the expiration time.
